originality.rationale: The exact weighted joint spectrum of rational points on each smooth binary plane quartic and F2-rational even-contact lines, with 25 supported cells and exact Fano-line subset frequencies, is not stated in the inspected primary sources. Nart--Ritzenthaler already provide complete characteristic-two normal forms and geometric bitangent/Fano classification; these are expressly excluded from novelty. Their broader classification may allow the same table to be computed, creating an honest priority risk, but does not itself contain the asserted bivariate statistic. Actual targeted published-finding corpus and literature searches found no equivalent completed table.
residual_risks: All characteristics-two quartics are completely classified by Nart--Ritzenthaler; the new F2 joint table might be reproducible as an easy postprocessing of a prior unindexed data set, requiring further priority verification.
The literature search cannot establish absolute novelty or absence from unindexed tables.
The Markwig--Payne--Shaw tropical results have different ground-field hypotheses; they motivate the arithmetic question but provide no positive-characteristic-two inference.

value.rationale: A natural arithmetic-genus-three question asks how rational theta-contact lines and rational point existence are jointly distributed. The 25-cell weighted joint spectrum determines sharp forbidden pairs and two qualitatively different parity regimes for 3 versus 4 rational bitangents, plus exact Fano incidence multiplicities, data not supplied by the known isomorphism classification or single-invariant counts. This complete, exact first-small-field boundary has plausible uses in arithmetic enumeration and descent benchmarks without claiming an all-fields theorem.
